aboutText: All Electric Homes, based in Keysborough, has pioneered home energy upgrades since 2025. We have delivered over 650 upgrades, saving households more than $373,000 in energy costs. Our services improve performance, comfort, and control, making your home smarter and cheaper to run. Trust our local expertise for tailored energy solutions.
servicesText: We offer a range of energy services including battery installation, home upgrades, and council programs. Our team in Keysborough specialises in maximising energy savings and efficiency for every household. From rebate assistance to shutdown support, we cover all aspects of home energy management.

services.title: Battery Installation & Rebates
services.desc: We handle the entire process from selection to installation, ensuring you qualify for available rebates and save on energy costs.

services.title: Home Energy Upgrades
services.desc: Our team assesses and implements upgrades to enhance energy efficiency, comfort, and value in your Keysborough home.

services.title: Hume City Council Programs
services.desc: Participate in council-sponsored energy upgrade schemes designed for Hume residents, with our expert guidance and support.

services.title: Bayside Council Programs
services.desc: Access special energy programs through Bayside Council, supported by our local knowledge and professional installation services.

services.title: Energy Shutdown Support
services.desc: Receive immediate assistance during planned or unplanned energy shutdowns, minimising disruption to your daily life and safety.

services.title: Energy Efficiency Consultations
services.desc: Get personalised advice on reducing energy consumption and costs, tailored to your home's specific needs and goals.
